answer.content: This investigation focuses on verifying the presence of explicit descriptions in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 regarding memory retrieval mechanisms triggered by contextual perturbations. The analysis will identify any specified perturbation types, magnitudes, timing, and associated metrics such as fidelity or latency that quantify retrieval performance. If no such mechanisms are described, a minimal operational definition of retrieval-based memory integrity will be proposed under clear, verifiable conditions to anchor future comparative evaluations without unsupported claims. All findings must be strictly derived from the provided source text and avoid speculative or implementative extensions.
